semantics.note: 'We are about to have' is firm, unhedged language, so this is a forecast. 'Soon' fairly renders 'about to'. Reading 'fake videos' as AI-generated fits the Sora context.

contract.note: Reading 'a whole generation educated by' as a large, generation-wide source of children's learning is a fair, ordinary reading. No deadline was stated, and the contract correctly says isolated reports are not enough.

evidence.note: Feb 2026 summary of an NYT review: false 'educational' AI videos are recommended to toddlers. It gives no share or reach across children, so it cannot meet the generation-wide threshold.

reviews.rationale: The forecast has no deadline. The only evidence shows such videos exist and are recommended to young children. It does not show they have become a generation-wide source of learning, and there is no representative data either way. The early-resolution rule is not met and the contradiction condition is not met, so the claim is unresolved.
